title: The Original E-Man 1 & 2 - 1985 First Comics Lot of 2 Comics
descriptionText: The Original E-Man 1 & 2 from 1985 are part of a lot of two comics published by First Comics. Created by Maus, these comics showcase the character E-Man in the Copper Age era of US Comics. The genre focuses on comics, and the series title is E-Man, offering collectors a piece of comic book history from the mid-1980s.
